title: Ultraverse Firearm Volume 1 Issue #13 September 1994 Malibu Comics 1993
descriptionText: The product is Ultraverse Firearm Volume 1 Issue #13 from September 1994 by Malibu Comics. This comic book is part of the Ultraverse series and features a boarded edition. Published in 1993, it follows the tradition of US Comics and offers fans of the genre a new installment to enjoy. With its focused storyline and exciting artwork, this comic is a must-have for collectors and fans of the Ultraverse universe.
